title: Petition for Annulment

signers.label: Signing Party (Party One or Party Two)
signers.note: The 'signing_party' choice field selects which already-collected name (party_one_name or party_two_name) this refers to -- route the handoff to that person.

signers.label: Court Authority
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval -- not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: No source Google Doc -- built directly from Bar Procedures Section 2D. Unlike a divorce, an annulment is only granted on grounds of fraud, awards no division of assets regardless of prenups, and reverts both parties to any prior names -- so this template collects the fraud allegation and each party's pre-marriage name instead of a general 'specific requests' field.

fields.label: Party One
fields.prompt: What is Party One's full name?

fields.label: Party One CID
fields.prompt: What is Party One's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Party One's Prior Name
fields.prompt: Did Party One change their legal name when this marriage was registered? If so, what was their name before? (Answer "No Change" if it didn't change.)

fields.label: Party Two
fields.prompt: What is Party Two's full name?

fields.label: Party Two CID
fields.prompt: What is Party Two's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Party Two's Prior Name
fields.prompt: Did Party Two change their legal name when this marriage was registered? If so, what was their name before? (Answer "No Change" if it didn't change.)

fields.label: Grounds for Annulment (Fraud)
fields.prompt: An annulment is only granted on grounds of fraud. Describe the fraud you're alleging and how it affected the marriage.

fields.label: Either Party (Selection)
fields.prompt: Which party is signing to request this annulment — Party One or Party Two?
fields.note: Selects which already-collected name (party_one_name or party_two_name) becomes the signing_party_signature. Not displayed on the document itself.

fields.label: Either Party (Signing)
fields.note: Value is whichever of party_one_name/party_two_name matches the 'signing_party' selection, confirmed by that person directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Court Authority
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a judge grants the annulment after a hearing -- never asked of the applicants.
